title.narrative: With UNICEF’s support, the Government has transitioned to scaling their community-based integrated Early Childhood Development (ECD) programme. The programme reached 31,205 children 0-8 years with essential ECD services, and supported substantive progress on the ECD and Early Childhood Education (ECE) policies, including finalization and launch of key ECE curriculum documents.
